headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 7, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, winning 15-1 behind a strong performance from Noah Cameron. Tyler Tolbert led the Royals' offense with 5 hits, including 1 HR and 2 RBI. In other action, the New York Yankees secured a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Cam Schlittler pitching a strong 8.0 innings, allowing 1 ER and striking out 8 batters. José Caballero led the Yankees' offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Milwaukee Brewers third baseman David Hamilton, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a strained left hamstring. The Brewers also transferred left fielder Brandon Lockridge from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right knee laceration and contusion. Other teams with injured players include the St. Louis Cardinals, Atlanta Braves, Milwaukee Brewers, Colorado Rockies, and Milwaukee Brewers.

The New York Mets made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for cash. The Mets also acquired right-handed pitcher Woo-Suk Go from the Minnesota Twins in a separate trade. Other trades include the Philadelphia Phillies trading right-handed pitcher Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash, and the Houston Astros trading left-handed pitcher Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Royals Rout Phillies 15-1**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, winning 15-1 behind a strong performance from Noah Cameron, who earned the win with 5.0 IP, 7 K, and 1 ER. Tyler Tolbert led the Royals' offense with 5 hits, including 1 HR and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Rays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Cam Schlittler pitching a strong 8.0 innings, allowing 1 ER and striking out 8 batters. José Caballero led the Yankees' offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Come from Behind to Win 11-12**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals overcame a 5-run deficit to defeat the Houston Astros 11-12 in a thrilling matchup. CJ Abrams led the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Edge Braves in Thrilling 7-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a hard-fought 7-6 win over the Atlanta Braves, with Brooks Raley earning the win and Luke Weaver securing the save.

top_news.title: **Brewers Place David Hamilton on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers third baseman David Hamilton has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a strained left hamstring. The move was made on July 7, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return.
